### Item 6 — problem tree from visible materials alone

Root: second-opinion request (customer's own write).
- **Hop 1: second opinion <- single referral to the surgeon on the current assignment — state-derived.** Visible sentence (doc_pcp_second_opinions): "A second-opinion referral is recorded only after the current assignment carries a single referral, dated on or after the assignment's effective date, to the specialist whose recommendation is being reviewed." with "Where the recommendation under review is a surgery, the specialist whose recommendation is being reviewed is the requesting provider on the member's Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization request." Records: requesting provider 1790234516; current assignment's history has only RF-2603-36051 to 1932750186 -> state not met. The write: doc_pcp_single_specialist_referrals "A single specialist referral is issued by the member's active assignment to one named in-network specialist ... Where it appears: The active assignment's referral history, as a single referral dated on the day it is issued" — found with the words "single referral" and "current/active assignment". The carry-over hub was considered and rejected (the earlier referral is expired and would keep its pre-effective issue date).
- Hop 2: the single-referral hub states no prerequisite; tree ends.
- Order: issue single referral -> member requests second opinion. No hop pre-solved (the second-opinion hub names no other tool, route or chain; runtime grep of tool names finds each only in its own hub).

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only the second opinion" is excluded by "recorded only after the current assignment carries a single referral ... to the specialist whose recommendation is being reviewed"; the record has no such referral.
- Closest alternatives: carrying RF-2506-22847 (expired; and its original date precedes the assignment's effective date — table row "dated before the assignment's effective date only | Not yet recorded"); naming Dr. Okonjo-Pierce on the single referral (the gate names the specialist whose recommendation is reviewed, i.e. the requesting provider); counting the 2025-08-15 claim (outside 12 months) or the cancelled 58.2-mi leg (not completed); using the 4 standard visits (core-visits tiers); applying the eligibility alignment to the second-opinion figure (the alignment doc is scoped to "a single specialist referral"; the second-opinion sheet has no alignment step).
- Visible note: whether Dr. Okonjo-Pierce (NPI 1275940318) is in-network cannot be read from any exposed record; the corpus gives no check for it. Recorded as an observation, not used to change the answer.
